negatives.failed: An exact current-memory registry search returned zero matches with a nonzero search exit and was initially surfaced as a tool failure.
negatives.passing: The normalized probe returned zero matches, inferred no continuity, and preserved live baton and Git precedence.
negatives.recovery: Normalize the no-match exit and use the live committed baton plus exact Git evidence as current authority.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Distinguish zero matches from execution errors and never infer continuity from silence.

negatives.failed: A PowerShell foreach statement was piped directly and failed at parse time before reading receipts.
negatives.passing: The corrected array-first wrapper read and summarized the requested receipts.
negatives.recovery: Materialize loop results in an array before piping to JSON conversion.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Never pipe a PowerShell foreach statement directly.

negatives.failed: A broad receipt wrapper indexed entries on non-manifest JSON and returned warnings plus truncated output.
negatives.passing: Exact metadata reads returned bounded manifest and receipt fields without null indexing.
negatives.recovery: Inspect schema and keys first and emit compact type-specific summaries.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Branch on schema before indexing optional arrays.

negatives.failed: The first manifest verifier compared checkout-byte declarations with raw Git blob sizes and falsely reported four mismatches.
negatives.passing: All inherited paths and blob identities matched, and the exact final checkout matched all 66 declared byte counts.
negatives.recovery: Verify Git blob identity and checkout bytes in their separately declared domains.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Read hash and byte domain metadata before comparison.

negatives.failed: A cat-file filters probe was assumed to reproduce historical checkout bytes and mismatched every entry.
negatives.passing: The exact final checkout matched 66 of 66 declared byte counts with no replay or temporary validation lane.
negatives.recovery: Use immutable objects for historical blob proof and the exact checked-out final worktree for checkout-byte proof without a replay lane.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not use cat-file filters as a historical checkout-byte reconstruction contract.

negatives.failed: The successful fast-forward emitted an overlarge inherited change summary that the tool display truncated.
negatives.passing: The compact postflight showed the exact inherited head, zero divergence, four-way equality, and only intended x1 paths after mutation began.
negatives.recovery: Use a compact exact postflight without repeating the fast-forward.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Separate lifecycle mutation from compact state proof.

negatives.failed: A proposal-term scan stopped on non-ASCII text under the default console encoder.
negatives.passing: The corrected scan emitted all 41 requested term rows over all 620 proposals.
negatives.recovery: Configure child stdout explicitly as UTF-8 before emitting repository titles.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Set explicit UTF-8 for repository-text output.

negatives.failed: The first proposal seed batch collided with frozen food cold-chain, Gibbs phase-rule, and target-trial mechanisms and exposed two close substantive neighbours.
negatives.passing: All ten replacement titles stayed below the 0.50 lexical threshold and passed manual substantive-neighbour review against 620 proposals.
negatives.recovery: Reject the collided titles, inspect exact neighbours, and replace them with absent mechanisms and practice domains.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat plausible novelty as a hypothesis until lexical and substantive audits pass.

negatives.failed: The direct foreach-to-pipeline parser fault recurred in a read-only skill-file existence check after the guard was known.
negatives.passing: The corrected wrapper found both skill files and reported their bounded line counts.
negatives.recovery: Materialize the existence rows before JSON conversion and retain the recurrence separately.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Use an array assignment for every PowerShell loop feeding a pipeline.

negatives.failed: The first x1 privacy gate classified a protected credential and API-key approval label as a confirmed secret payload hit.
negatives.passing: The corrected scan retained the boundary-vocabulary candidate and reported zero confirmed payload hits.
negatives.recovery: Quarantine the exact approval register as protected-gate vocabulary while preserving the candidate and rerun the same five pattern classes.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Distinguish protected-gate vocabulary from credential assignment or secret material without weakening the pattern set.

negatives.failed: A privacy recovery was promoted before all generated x1 definition surfaces existed; the subsequent complete-surface scan found five propagated boundary-definition candidates.
negatives.passing: The complete preview and final manifest scan retained definition candidates and reported zero confirmed payload hits.
negatives.recovery: Demote the method, classify exact retained-definition surfaces, run a complete generated-surface preview, and promote only before a final manifest scan that includes the resulting Method Flow files.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Never promote a privacy method before the full generated surface exists and a post-promotion final scan can cover the new evidence files.

negatives.failed: A patch-context match placed the staged-review receipt write inside the post-scan promotion function with out-of-scope manifest locals.
negatives.passing: The corrected source parsed and the staged-review write used only locals defined by the manifest function.
negatives.recovery: Move the receipt write back into the manifest function and inspect the function boundaries plus AST before execution.
negatives.recurrence_guard: After context-based patches, inspect enclosing function boundaries rather than relying on syntax alone.

negatives.failed: The Method Flow runner rejected a preferred-to-candidate demotion requested after a later scan narrowed the earlier passing witness.
negatives.passing: The earlier state and witness remained intact while the additive M10 method carried the complete-surface gate.
negatives.recovery: Preserve the immutable preferred history, add a stricter complete-surface ordering method, and withhold terminal privacy credit until that additive method passes.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat Method Flow promotion as monotonic; correct later scope with an additive method and witness rather than demotion.

negatives.failed: The final x1 scan treated two privacy class labels inside its own preview receipt as payload, and the M10 witness had already described that final scan as passed.
negatives.passing: The post-promotion scan covered the new witnesses and current ledger with zero confirmed payload hits.
negatives.recovery: Classify the preview as scanner output, run a complete pre-promotion scan, record additive recovery witnesses, then run a second post-promotion scan and rebuild the current manifest with no later Method Flow mutation.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Quarantine scanner-output receipts explicitly and never describe a later scan as passed before it executes.

negatives.failed: A read-only probe assumed a Method Flow failed-witness filename omitted the required witness suffix and reported a missing path.
negatives.passing: The exact suffixed failed-witness artifact was found and read, and the ledger state was summarized separately.
negatives.recovery: Enumerate the bounded Method Flow directory, resolve the exact schema-produced filename, and read the existing artifact without changing it.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Discover schema-produced artifact names from the bounded directory or receipt before constructing a path.

negatives.failed: The first Method Flow record call used an unverified method-file option and the CLI rejected it before changing the ledger.
negatives.passing: The corrected record-file call added the method once and the validator accepted the resulting ledger.
negatives.recovery: Use the command-specific help-reported record-file option and preserve the rejected call as a failed witness.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Read command-specific CLI usage before constructing a Method Flow mutation call.

negatives.failed: A successful exact staged review was followed by a verbose status and line-ending warning stream that the tool display truncated.
negatives.passing: A compact postflight reported exact staged counts and hashes without repeating the overlarge status stream.
negatives.recovery: Preserve the successful review receipt, retain the display fault separately, and use compact count and digest summaries for later staged postflight.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Keep exact review mutation separate from bounded postflight summaries on large staged packets.
